description: Candidate semantic hints for active-learning and Bayesian-optimization artifacts. These hints classify roles; they do not establish physical units, material identity, or experimental validation.

x.note: A design coordinate or feature; its physical meaning and unit must be supplied by the researcher.

y.note: A design coordinate or feature; its physical meaning and unit must be supplied by the researcher.

z.note: A target/objective column. Determine whether it is measured, simulated, or a benchmark function before treating it as material evidence.

acquisition_value.note: An acquisition-function score used to rank candidates; it is not a predicted property value or a measurement.

qbc_variance.note: Disagreement among model acquisition scores; it is not experimental uncertainty.

file_rules.caution: The presence of z does not prove that z is experimentally measured.
Candidate coordinates have no observed target until an experiment or trusted simulation is recorded.
This is a pool assembled for selection, not a validated result.
Recommendations are proposed experiments until measured or independently simulated.
QBC variance ranks disagreement; it does not quantify laboratory uncertainty.
A plot is a visual diagnostic and cannot replace the source table or measurement record.
